records.title: My Application Tasks page and record identity

sources.locator: To Do tab rendering applications.subTabs.todo at data-reader-view=todo; applicationMyTodoPage read dispatch

payload.purpose: Personal Licensing review applications and tasks.
entryConditions: Authenticated Admin user; current page and operation permissions. Personal ownership is verified upstream, not inferred from the role label.
readinessAssertions: Current selected tab is known; its successful permitted response is present; loading has ended. A blocked call or default zero card is not an empty result.

detailEntry.meaning: Use the matched current row workflow task ID. applicationNumber and id cannot be substituted. Multiple matching task IDs require a verified view/task selection.

scopeBoundaries: The same application may move across approval departments; the current task approval department controls the queue.
Team analysis belongs to the corresponding Team Management entry; issued licenses belong to the Licenses entry.

On this personal Licensing My Application Tasks page, the actual Arabic To Do tab label is قيد الإنجاز (applications.subTabs.todo), and the My Tasks label is مهامي (applications.tabs.myTasks). In a reference to this page/tab or personal queue, the native label identifies the To Do pending-work view; it does not assert that every application status equals an English In Progress literal. It does not change the authenticated personal scope, runtime department or request filters. Explicit requests for a stored application/process status, additional status predicates, negation or another page/entity must retain those requirements rather than be converted to queue membership. The statistics card reuses the same label but is a different count source, not proof of list completeness.
payload.recordLookup: Exact-match the supplied business number against observed rows. unique=false deliberately retains ambiguity checks; a substring search or first page alone does not establish uniqueness.
payload.writeOperations: Approve, reject, reassign, send back, modification, recall and deletion are business mutations; listing them does not enable them in the Reader.
constraints: Source-inspected definitions; the remote deployed build has not been matched to this snapshot. Validate current authorized response shape and request context before using these definitions.
This page knowledge does not authorize API access or business writes. A blocked or failed response is not an empty population.
A bounded page is not a complete population. Counts and grouping require complete collection at the requested entity grain and stable request context.
